name: paymenter_manage_credit
description: Manage prepaid credit balance for a customer (deposit, deduct, set balance, or view credit records).

action.description: Operation to perform: 'get' to check balance, 'add' to deposit, 'deduct' to spend, 'set' to overwrite.

user_id.description: Customer ID who owns the credit wallet.

amount.description: Credit amount to deposit, deduct, or set (required for 'add', 'deduct', 'set').

credit_id.description: Specific credit record ID when updating existing balance record directly.
